title: Fillet of cod with saffron mashed potatoes and olive tapenade
description: This fish supper is elevated with saffron-infused potatoes and a spicy white wine sauce to create something fitting for any special occasion.

steps.text: To make the fish stock, preheat the oven to 200C/180C Fan/Gas 6.
steps.raw: To make the fish stock, preheat the oven to 200C/180C Fan/Gas 6.

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large roasting tin. Add the fish bones, vegetables and thyme and turn until everything evenly coated. Roast for 30 minutes.
steps.raw: Melt the butter in a large roasting tin. Add the fish bones, vegetables and thyme and turn until everything evenly coated. Roast for 30 minutes.

steps.text: Transfer everything to a large saucepan, add 2.25 litres/4 pints water and bring just to the boil.
steps.raw: Transfer everything to a large saucepan, add 2.25 litres/4 pints water and bring just to the boil.

steps.text: Simmer for 20 minutes, then strain through a muslin-lined sieve into a clean saucepan.
steps.raw: Simmer for 20 minutes, then strain through a muslin-lined sieve into a clean saucepan.

steps.text: Return to the heat and boil until reduced to approximately 1.2 litres/2 pints. Set aside.
steps.raw: Return to the heat and boil until reduced to approximately 1.2 litres/2 pints. Set aside.

steps.text: To make the mayonnaise in a food processor or blender, place the egg, vinegar and salt in a food processor or blender.
steps.raw: To make the mayonnaise in a food processor or blender, place the egg, vinegar and salt in a food processor or blender.

steps.text: With the motor running, gradually add the oil until a thick emulsion forms.
steps.raw: With the motor running, gradually add the oil until a thick emulsion forms.

steps.text: To make by hand, ensure all of the ingredients are at room temperature.
steps.raw: To make by hand, ensure all of the ingredients are at room temperature.

steps.text: Place the egg yolks, vinegar and salt in a bowl and whisk continuously while adding the oil a few drops at a time.
steps.raw: Place the egg yolks, vinegar and salt in a bowl and whisk continuously while adding the oil a few drops at a time.

steps.text: Once the mixture begins to emulsify, gradually increase the rate at which the oil is added until fully incorporated. Set aside.
steps.raw: Once the mixture begins to emulsify, gradually increase the rate at which the oil is added until fully incorporated. Set aside.

steps.text: To make the sauce, heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the carrot, onion, chilli and orange zest for 5 minutes.
steps.raw: To make the sauce, heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the carrot, onion, chilli and orange zest for 5 minutes.

steps.text: Add the orange juice, wine, tomato and 600ml/20fl oz roasted fish stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
steps.raw: Add the orange juice, wine, tomato and 600ml/20fl oz roasted fish stock and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.text: Season with salt and white pepper, then strain the sauce through a sieve into a jug.
steps.raw: Season with salt and white pepper, then strain the sauce through a sieve into a jug.

steps.text: Place 4 tablespoons olive oil mayonnaise in a small saucepan over a low heat and gradually whisk in the strained sauce.
steps.raw: Place 4 tablespoons olive oil mayonnaise in a small saucepan over a low heat and gradually whisk in the strained sauce.

steps.text: Cook gently until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Do not allow it to boil. Keep warm.
steps.raw: Cook gently until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Do not allow it to boil. Keep warm.

steps.text: To make the mashed potatoes, place the potatoes in a saucepan and barely cover with cold water.
steps.raw: To make the mashed potatoes, place the potatoes in a saucepan and barely cover with cold water.

steps.text: Add the saffron and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil and cook for approximately 20 minutes, or until tender.
steps.raw: Add the saffron and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil and cook for approximately 20 minutes, or until tender.

steps.text: Drain the cooking liquid into a clean small saucepan and boil rapidly until reduced to 4–6 tablespoons.
steps.raw: Drain the cooking liquid into a clean small saucepan and boil rapidly until reduced to 4–6 tablespoons.

steps.text: Mash the potatoes until smooth.
steps.raw: Mash the potatoes until smooth.

steps.text: Beat in the reduced cooking liquid, garlic, oil and cream. Season with salt and pepper. Keep warm.
steps.raw: Beat in the reduced cooking liquid, garlic, oil and cream. Season with salt and pepper. Keep warm.

steps.text: To make the cod, preheat the grill to high and oil the grill rack.
steps.raw: To make the cod, preheat the grill to high and oil the grill rack.

steps.text: Brush both sides of the cod with the oil and season with coarse sea salt and pepper.
steps.raw: Brush both sides of the cod with the oil and season with coarse sea salt and pepper.

steps.text: Place the cod on the grill rack, skin-side up, and cook for 8 minutes, or until cooked through.
steps.raw: Place the cod on the grill rack, skin-side up, and cook for 8 minutes, or until cooked through.

steps.text: To make the tapenade, mix all of the ingredients together in a blender and blend to a purée.
steps.raw: To make the tapenade, mix all of the ingredients together in a blender and blend to a purée.

steps.text: To serve, spoon the saffron mashed potatoes into the centre of four warmed plates.
steps.raw: To serve, spoon the saffron mashed potatoes into the centre of four warmed plates.

steps.text: Place a piece of cod on top of each mound of potato. Pour the sauce evenly around the edge of the plates.
steps.raw: Place a piece of cod on top of each mound of potato. Pour the sauce evenly around the edge of the plates.

steps.text: Garnish with the tomatoes and parsley. Add 2 teaspoons of tapenade to each plate and serve immediately.
steps.raw: Garnish with the tomatoes and parsley. Add 2 teaspoons of tapenade to each plate and serve immediately.

recipeInstructions: To make the fish stock, preheat the oven to 200C/180C Fan/Gas 6.
Melt the butter in a large roasting tin. Add the fish bones, vegetables and thyme and turn until everything evenly coated. Roast for 30 minutes.

Simmer for 20 minutes, then strain through a muslin-lined sieve into a clean saucepan.
Return to the heat and boil until reduced to approximately 1.2 litres/2 pints. Set aside.
To make the mayonnaise in a food processor or blender, place the egg, vinegar and salt in a food processor or blender.
With the motor running, gradually add the oil until a thick emulsion forms.
To make by hand, ensure all of the ingredients are at room temperature.
Place the egg yolks, vinegar and salt in a bowl and whisk continuously while adding the oil a few drops at a time.
Once the mixture begins to emulsify, gradually increase the rate at which the oil is added until fully incorporated. Set aside.
To make the sauce, heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the carrot, onion, chilli and orange zest for 5 minutes.
Add the orange juice, wine, tomato and 600ml/20fl oz roasted fish stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and white pepper, then strain the sauce through a sieve into a jug.
Place 4 tablespoons olive oil mayonnaise in a small saucepan over a low heat and gradually whisk in the strained sauce.
Cook gently until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Do not allow it to boil. Keep warm.
To make the mashed potatoes, place the potatoes in a saucepan and barely cover with cold water.
Add the saffron and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil and cook for approximately 20 minutes, or until tender.
Drain the cooking liquid into a clean small saucepan and boil rapidly until reduced to 4–6 tablespoons.
Mash the potatoes until smooth.
Beat in the reduced cooking liquid, garlic, oil and cream. Season with salt and pepper. Keep warm.

Brush both sides of the cod with the oil and season with coarse sea salt and pepper.
Place the cod on the grill rack, skin-side up, and cook for 8 minutes, or until cooked through.
To make the tapenade, mix all of the ingredients together in a blender and blend to a purée.
To serve, spoon the saffron mashed potatoes into the centre of four warmed plates.
Place a piece of cod on top of each mound of potato. Pour the sauce evenly around the edge of the plates.
Garnish with the tomatoes and parsley. Add 2 teaspoons of tapenade to each plate and serve immediately.
